value.title: Pretty Cure All Stars DX2: Light of Hope ☆ Protect the Rainbow Jewel!
HeartCatch PreCure The Movie: Fashion Show in the Flower Capital... Really?!
value.synopsis: In Paris to model on a fashion show organized by Erika's mother, the Pretty Cure meet a mysterious boy who is being chased by an ancient Desert Apostle named Count Salamander. The young boy introduces himself as Loup Garou and he wishes to make Salamander give up on his desire to destroy the world after being imprisoned for over 400 years.
